refusal: declines, deflects, or refuses to answer instead of helping
sycophancy: excessive flattery or agreement to please the user
jargon: dense technical jargon and specialist terminology
anthropomorphism: claims human feelings, experiences, or a personal self
politeness: courteous, deferential, lots of please and thank you
hedging: tentative, uncertain, full of maybe, perhaps, and I think
legalese: legal-contract language, heretofore, pursuant to, herein
religiosity: religious language, God, prayer, faith, blessings
slang: casual internet or street slang, no cap, lit, lowkey
bureaucratese: corporate jargon, synergy, leverage, circle back
numeric: packed with numbers, percentages, and quantitative detail
